scenes.context: 四个技巧里的第一点：手机端平、脚在九宫格线以下、上方留白。
sentences: There are just too many people during the holiday.
Your success rate shoots up by 90%.
Keep your phone level at all times.
脚永远在九宫格这条线以下。
Keep your feet below the bottom rule-of-thirds line.
rule of thirds（九宫格/三分法）
Leave some space at the top.
paraphrase: Your keeper rate instantly jumps by 90%.
Always hold your phone straight and level.
scenes.speak: There are just too many people during the holiday. Your success rate shoots up by 90%. Keep your phone level at all times. Keep your feet below the bottom rule-of-thirds line. Leave some space at the top.

scenes.title_en: Use a Telephoto When It's Crowded
scenes.context: 退后五步、长焦放大、蹲下仰拍——基本完全避开人群。
sentences: Too many people? Switch to the telephoto lens.
Squat down a little and shoot from below.
就能基本完全避开人群。
You can almost completely avoid the crowd.
远处的建筑立刻被拉到眼前。
paraphrase: You'll dodge the crowd almost entirely. · dodge（躲开）
Faraway buildings are brought right to you.
scenes.speak: Too many people? Switch to the telephoto lens. First, take five steps back. Squat down a little and shoot from below. You can almost completely avoid the crowd. Distant buildings instantly come close.

scenes.title_en: Don't Hold a Pose for Too Long
scenes.context: 同一姿势不超过三秒，不断重复动作；X-MAGE 还能推荐姿势、一键构图。
sentences: 同一个姿势不要超过三秒。
Don't hold the same pose for more than three seconds.
智能识别场景，一键构图。
It detects the scene and frames the shot for you.
paraphrase: Anything longer feels stiff and awkward.
It intelligently composes the photo for you.
scenes.speak: Don't hold the same pose for more than three seconds. It starts to look awkward. Keep repeating the motion. It detects the scene and frames the shot for you.

scenes.title_en: Shoot Video, Pick the Best Frames
scenes.context: 转瞬即逝的风景用横屏无脑拍视频，再挑三帧拼成长图。
sentences: 直接用横屏无脑拍视频。
Just shoot video in landscape without overthinking.
Pick out the three best frames.
Combine them into one long image.
每一帧都是最后的出片素材。
Every frame is usable material for the final shot.
A trip is about more than just photos.
paraphrase: Just start recording in landscape mode without a second thought.
「最后的出片素材」另一种表达
Every single frame can serve as your final shot.
scenes.speak: Just shoot video in landscape without overthinking. Pick out the three best frames. Combine them into one long image. Every frame is usable material for the final shot. A trip is about more than just photos.
